title: How TPRS works — and how to get the most from SpanishNow
heading: How TPRS works
subtitle: and how to get the most from SpanishNow
bullets: Stage 1, structures: before each story you meet three new structures (short words or phrases). You only need to recognize them, not memorize them.
Stage 2, the story: the story arrives in short scenes, each with a picture, audio and one or two easy questions. Every scene is a message you can already understand.
Stage 3, reading: at the end you read the whole story and practice with cards and matching. What you understood by ear, you now recognize in writing.
What is "circling"? We ask about the same sentence again and again in different ways: yes or no, this or that. Many meaningful repetitions, without boring drills.
Why repeat out loud? When you listen and repeat, your ears and your mouth learn together. Your pronunciation improves without thinking about rules.
Listen to each story twice. The first time, listen for the meaning. The second time, listen for the sound: you will notice details you missed before.
Do not translate word by word and do not memorize grammar. Tap the highlighted words when you need help, answer even if you are not sure, and trust the repetition.
closing: You will understand more than you think.
